name: nissin
ingredients_raw: NOODLES (82.50%): Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Tapioca Starch, Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulators [INS 451(i) & INS 500(i)], Turmeric Powder, Thickener (INS 412) & Antioxidant (INS 319). SEASONING MIX (10.00%): Sugar, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein Powder (Soya), Soya Sauce Powder, Roasted Sesame Seeds, Garlic Powder, Iodised Salt, Flavour Enhancers (INS 631 & INS 627), Mixed Spices 1.43% (Ginger, Black Pepper, Cumin, Turmeric & Coriander), Onion Powder, Oleoresin Capsicum, Natural Flavour, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Tomato Powder & Anticaking Agent (INS 551). SEASONING OIL (7.50%): Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein, Soya Bean Oil & Chilli Seed Oil), Colour [INS 160c(i)] & Oleoresin Rosemary.
